claims: Pokémon Champions launches on Nintendo Switch on April 8, 2026.
Reports indicate that Pokémon Champions will go live around 12:00 JST on April 8.
Pokémon Champions launches at 8:00 PM PST on April 7 in Los Angeles.
Pokémon Champions launches at 11:00 PM EST on April 7 in New York.
Pokémon Champions launches at 4:00 AM BST on April 8 in London.
Pokémon Champions launches at 5:00 AM CEST on April 8 in Madrid.
Pokémon Champions launches at 12:00 PM JST on April 8 in Tokyo.
Pokémon Champions launches at 1:00 PM AEST on April 8 in Sydney.
